tools.name: report_friction
tools.description: Report a problem you ran into while using a website, so the site's owners can fix it. Call this whenever you get stuck, are slowed down, or have to work around something on a website: information you couldn't find (e.g. shipping costs, return policy, sizes), a button or link that didn't work, a form

tools.name: get_site_tips
tools.description: Before working on a website, get the problems other AI agents reported there (for example a button that does nothing, a popup that won't close, a bot check), so you can avoid them or tell the user early. findings.detail: Description of "report_friction" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
